title: Intel Makes Its Smartphone Move With Latest Atom
text: Apple ( AAPL ) has its own chip, Nvidia ( NVDA ) is in the field and Qualcomm ( QCOM ) is there too with Snapdragon. Simply put, Intel has cut the power consumption in the Atom down to the point where it can be a consideration for smartphone makers.
